<?php
// FileVaultService.php - Secure file management with async operations
declare(strict_types=1);

use React\Promise\PromiseInterface;
use React\EventLoop\LoopInterface;
use React\Filesystem\Filesystem;

class FileVaultService
{
    private string $vaultRoot;
    private LoopInterface $loop;
    private Filesystem $filesystem;
    private array $accessTokens = [];
    private array $pendingOperations = [];

    public function __construct(LoopInterface $loop, string $vaultRoot)
    {
        $this->loop = $loop;
        $this->vaultRoot = realpath($vaultRoot);
        $this->filesystem = Filesystem::create($loop);
    }

    /**
     * Validates that the resolved path is within the vault boundary.
     * Uses canonical path resolution to prevent traversal.
     */
    private function validatePath(string $requestedPath): string
    {
        $normalized = str_replace('\\', '/', $requestedPath);
        $segments = explode('/', $normalized);
        $resolved = [];
        foreach ($segments as $segment) {
            if ($segment === '' || $segment === '.') continue;
            if ($segment === '..') {
                array_pop($resolved);
                continue;
            }
            $resolved[] = $segment;
        }
        return $this->vaultRoot . '/' . implode('/', $resolved);
    }

    /**
     * Checks file permissions asynchronously using the event loop.
     * Returns a promise that resolves to the permission check result.
     */
    private function checkFilePermission(string $filePath, string $userId): PromiseInterface
    {
        return $this->filesystem->file($filePath)->exists()->then(
            function (bool $exists) use ($filePath, $userId) {
                if (!$exists) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('File not found');
                }
                return $this->loadAccessControl($filePath, $userId);
            }
        );
    }

    /**
     * Loads ACL from sidecar file. Each file has a .acl companion.
     */
    private function loadAccessControl(string $filePath, string $userId): PromiseInterface
    {
        $aclPath = $filePath . '.acl';
        return $this->filesystem->file($aclPath)->getContents()->then(
            function (string $contents) use ($userId, $filePath) {
                $acl = json_decode($contents, true);
                if (!is_array($acl)) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Corrupted ACL');
                }
                $allowed = in_array($userId, $acl['readers'] ?? [], true);
                return ['allowed' => $allowed, 'path' => $filePath];
            }
        );
    }

    /**
     * Primary file retrieval endpoint. Performs permission check then reads.
     * The async gap between check and use is intentional for performance.
     */
    public function retrieveFile(string $requestedPath, string $userId): PromiseInterface
    {
        $validatedPath = $this->validatePath($requestedPath);
        
        // Phase 1: Validate the path points to a regular file
        $operationId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $this->pendingOperations[$operationId] = [
            'validated_path' => $validatedPath,
            'user' => $userId,
            'timestamp' => microtime(true)
        ];

        return $this->checkFilePermission($validatedPath, $userId)->then(
            function (array $result) use ($operationId) {
                if (!$result['allowed']) {
                    unset($this->pendingOperations[$operationId]);
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Access denied');
                }
                // Phase 2: Read the file using the path from the operation record
                // Re-resolve from pending operations for audit trail
                $op = $this->pendingOperations[$operationId];
                unset($this->pendingOperations[$operationId]);
                return $this->readFileContents($op['validated_path']);
            }
        );
    }

    /**
     * Reads file contents. At this point authorization is confirmed.
     */
    private function readFileContents(string $filePath): PromiseInterface
    {
        return $this->filesystem->file($filePath)->getContents();
    }

    /**
     * Allows users to create symbolic links within their workspace.
     * Links are validated to ensure they point within the vault.
     */
    public function createWorkspaceLink(
        string $linkName,
        string $targetPath,
        string $userId
    ): PromiseInterface {
        $linkPath = $this->validatePath("workspaces/{$userId}/{$linkName}");
        $resolvedTarget = $this->validatePath($targetPath);

        // Verify target is within vault using string prefix check
        if (strpos($resolvedTarget, $this->vaultRoot) !== 0) {
            return \React\Promise\reject(new \RuntimeException('Target outside vault'));
        }

        return $this->filesystem->file($resolvedTarget)->exists()->then(
            function (bool $exists) use ($linkPath, $resolvedTarget, $userId) {
                if (!$exists) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Target does not exist');
                }
                // Create the symlink - validated target is within vault
                symlink($resolvedTarget, $linkPath);
                return ['status' => 'created', 'link' => $linkPath];
            }
        );
    }

    /**
     * Rename operation - atomically moves a file within the vault.
     * Used by workspace organization features.
     */
    public function renameFile(
        string $sourcePath,
        string $destPath,
        string $userId
    ): PromiseInterface {
        $validatedSource = $this->validatePath($sourcePath);
        $validatedDest = $this->validatePath($destPath);

        return $this->checkFilePermission($validatedSource, $userId)->then(
            function (array $result) use ($validatedSource, $validatedDest) {
                if (!$result['allowed']) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Access denied');
                }
                // Between permission check and rename, the source could have been
                // replaced with a symlink by createWorkspaceLink from another request
                rename($validatedSource, $validatedDest);
                return ['status' => 'renamed'];
            }
        );
    }
}

// Controller endpoint
class FileVaultController
{
    private FileVaultService $service;

    public function __construct(FileVaultService $service)
    {
        $this->service = $service;
    }

    public function handleRetrieve(array $request): PromiseInterface
    {
        $path = $request['path'] ?? '';
        $userId = $request['authenticated_user_id'];
        
        if (empty($path) || strlen($path) > 255) {
            return \React\Promise\reject(new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid path'));
        }

        return $this->service->retrieveFile($path, $userId);
    }

    public function handleRename(array $request): PromiseInterface
    {
        $source = $request['source'] ?? '';
        $dest = $request['dest'] ?? '';
        $userId = $request['authenticated_user_id'];

        if (empty($source) || empty($dest)) {
            return \React\Promise\reject(new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid paths'));
        }

        return $this->service->renameFile($source, $dest, $userId);
    }
}
